response.text: Hello! 😊 I am your WuWa Config Patcher AI Assistant. I can assist you with 1-Click Patching, Live Config Editing, CVar Section Guards, C# Environment, Shizuku & Root elevation, Log Decryption, CVar Analyzer, the CVar Bank, Duplicate Flagger, Forbidden CVar Stripper, Hardware/RAM recommendations, Settings & Danger Zone tools, and troubleshooting game bugs or crashes!

WuWa Config Patcher (io.github.arglax.configpatcher — Version v1.5.1, versionCode = 31) is a 100% free and open-source elevated Android utility developed by Arglax.

Tech stack: Kotlin 2.4.10, Jetpack Compose (Material 3), OkHttp 4, Retrofit 2 with KotlinX Serialization, AndroidX DocumentFile (SAF), Rikka Shizuku API, topjohnwu libsu Core 6.0.0, and Firebase BoM 34.16.0.
SDK targets: compileSdk 37, targetSdk 36, minSdk 30 (Android 11 minimum, Android 13+ recommended).

Update checking: The app queries app-version.txt on the GitHub repo via UpdateChecker.kt and shows an update dialog when a newer release is available. You can also tap Check for Updates under Settings > Application Info.

Releases and source are hosted on GitHub at Arglax/WuWa-Mobile-Config-Patcher. Supported game package variants: global, bilibili, kuro, tw, jp, and kr.

WuWa Config Patcher uses a single-activity layout with a 5-tab bottom navigation bar:
1. Config (ConfigScreen) — Presets, repository sync, and 1-Click Patch.
2. Editor (EditorScreen) — Smart / Text / One-Line config editing and Misc Patch.
3. Utilities (UtilitiesScreen) — Common subtab (logs, device info, vanilla revert) and Advanced subtab (CVar Analyzer, CVar Bank, Duplicate Flagger, Forbidden Stripper, Main Storage).
4. Settings (SettingsScreen) — Preferences, Elevated Access Status, Quick Jumps, and the Danger Zone.
5. Support (SupportScreen) — Developer notes, donations, bug report generator, Discord/GitHub links, and the WuWaLab companion app showcase.

1-Click Preset Patching Workflow (Tab 1: ConfigScreen):
1. Select Repository: Choose Arglax (Default) (connects to GitHub API via GitHubApi.kt to fetch custom-metadata.txt and zip archives), Custom Online Repository (direct HTTP/HTTPS .zip URL), or Local Repository (SAF folder picker via OpenDocumentTree()).
2. Sync: Tap Sync Files & Refresh (or pull down to refresh). This extracts archives via ZipExtractor.kt into context.cacheDir/repo_cache/ and parses folders with ConfigScanner.kt / ConfigNode.kt, using folder.walkTopDown() to find nested .ini files in deep subfolders.
3. Select Preset: Browse categories (STABLE, PERFORMANCE, HIGH_VISUAL, COMMUNITY, OTHER) assigned by PresetCategorization.kt.
4. Patch: Tap 1-Click Patch. It creates a timestamped backup in app_main_storage/backups/ via MainStorageManager.kt and injects configs via elevated Shizuku/Root IPC (ShizukuManager.applyAllIniFiles).
• Per-File Patching: Tap the Gear Icon (⚙️) next to 1-Click Patch (AdvancedPatchDialog.kt) to check/uncheck individual INI files.
• Tap Launch Game to detect the installed package variant (global/bilibili/kuro/tw/jp/kr) and launch Wuthering Waves immediately.

Live Config Editor (Tab 2: EditorScreen):
Supports editing Engine.ini (Gold), DeviceProfiles.ini (Gold), Scalability.ini, and GameUserSettings.ini (Green) via the top-left file dropdown. Files are read off device via ShizukuManager.readLogFile() and cached in memory for 0ms tab switching.

• Smart Mode: Sectioned UI cards. Features Sort A-Z (sortSmartSectionsAlphabetically()), Auto-Fix / Auto-Categorize, value steppers (with negative number support), and multi-select bulk delete.
• Text Mode: Syntax-highlighted raw editor with line numbers, Isolation Search Mode, Find & Replace ("Replace Next"/"Replace All"), and a font size slider (8sp-24sp). highlightIniContent splits on \n to preserve \r exactly, and a defensive safeMapping OffsetMapping clamps offsets to prevent IllegalStateException crashes when pasting text with Windows \r\n line endings — MainViewModel.kt also normalizes line endings in memory.
• One-Line Mode: Rapid dropdown selector with live buffer preview card before saving, plus interactive Add/Edit CVar dialogs with real-time section guard validation notes.

Engine CVar Section Guards (CVarSectionGuard.kt):
Unreal Engine ignores misplaced CVars. The patcher enforces canonical section headers:
• r. CVars → [/Script/Engine.RendererSettings] (except r.SupportAllShaderPermutations)
• r.SupportAllShaderPermutations, any other r. CVar, or dp. commands → also accepted by [/Script/Engine.RendererOverrideSettings] (whitelisted during Auto-Fix)
• s. CVars → [/Script/Engine.StreamingSettings]
• gc. CVars → [/Script/Engine.GarbageCollectionSettings]
• n.VerifyPeer, p.EnableMultiplayerWorldOriginRebasing, NetworkEmulationProfiles → [/Script/Engine.NetworkSettings]
• cook. CVars → [/Script/UnrealEd.CookerSettings]
• General CVars → [SystemSettings] or [ConsoleVariables] (universal containers that accept ANY CVars)

Protection Rules:
1. Misplaced lines & CVars= / +CVars= / .CVars= prefixes in Engine.ini are highlighted in bold Vibrant Red (#FF2222).
2. Tapping Save shows three options: Auto-Fix Sections (strips invalid prefixes and groups CVars into canonical headers), I know what I'm doing (bypasses and saves as-is), or Cancel.
3. [Core.Paths], [Core.System], and [/Script/Engine.RendererOverrideSettings] are whitelisted and NEVER moved, flagged, or altered.
4. DeviceProfiles.ini entries are automatically formatted as CVars=Key=Value without disturbing metadata pointers (BaseProfileName, DeviceScore, DeviceType, HardwareLevel).

Enabling C# Environment Scripting (Tab 2: Misc Patch):
Kuro Games built an experimental C# scripting runtime for Wuthering Waves that improves frame pacing, reduces CPU overhead, and speeds up asset streaming on supported hardware.

How to Enable:
1. Go to Editor Tab > Misc Patch subtab.
2. Check -ForceEnableCSharpEnvironment (and optionally -SkipSplash) and tap Patch. This pushes flags to .../files/UE4Game/Client/UE4CommandLine.txt.
3. Verification: Launch the game. An asterisk (*) at the end of the client version string on the splash screen confirms C# is active! In Utilities > Decrypted Log Explorer, search for Sharphereal entries.

⚠️ Hardware Note: 8 GB RAM is the minimum recommended requirement for C#. Devices with under 8 GB RAM may experience severe memory pressure or force-closing during combat scenes or map loading — disable this flag on those devices. See the full RAM tier breakdown for what to expect at each RAM level.

Reverting: If your device is unstable with C# enabled, reopen Misc Patch and uncheck -ForceEnableCSharpEnvironment, or tap Revert to Vanilla in Utilities.

Elevated Access Backends Hierarchy (target SDK 36 • Android 11–15+):
Android 11+ enforces Scoped Storage. WuWa Config Patcher supports 5 elevation backends, checked in this priority order:
• SHIZUKU (Green #47D764): Wireless Debugging / ADB IPC via rikka.shizuku.api (ShizukuManager.kt) — zero root needed.
• ROOT (Red #E35D6A): Native SU shell execution via topjohnwu libsu Core (v6.0.0), fallback if Shizuku is unavailable.
• AXMANAGER (Blue #2AA37D): Axeron shell provider integration (AxManagerManager.kt).
• SHIZUKU_UNAUTHORIZED (Orange #F7C948): Shizuku binder running, permission pending approval.
• NONE (Gray #A8B4AF): No elevated backend detected — the app prompts the setup wizard or falls back to Manual Mode.

Setting Up Shizuku:
1. Install Shizuku from Google Play or GitHub releases.
2. Connect to Wi-Fi (or enable Portable Wi-Fi Hotspot).
3. Enable Developer Options (tap Build Number 7 times in About Phone).
4. Enable USB Debugging and Wireless Debugging.
5. Open Shizuku, tap Pairing > Developer Options > Pair device with pairing code, and enter the 6-digit code.
6. Return to Shizuku and tap Start until status shows "Shizuku is running".
7. Open WuWa Config Patcher and grant Shizuku permission when prompted.
• Xiaomi / HyperOS / MIUI Fix: You must enable "USB Debugging (Security Settings)" in Developer Options (requires a signed-in Mi Account)!

Analyze Config (CVarAnalyzer.kt — Tab 3: Advanced Subtab):
Cross-checks active on-device INI CVars against decrypted Client.log execution blocks, resolving the latest instance near the end of the log.
• Report Dialog (ConfigAnalysisDialog.kt): Displays Total CVars, Applied %, Failed count, and Deleted/Ignored count & %, plus a collapsible Smart Insights panel with actionable recommendations.
• Status Codes:
- APPLIED: CVar value matched the executed engine value.
- FAILED / UNREAD: Game engine skipped or did not read the line.
- DELETED BY GAME: Game stripped or rejected the variable.
• Features: Combined tap-to-cycle CVar Filter (All / Applied / Failed / Deleted) + File Filter (All Files / Engine.ini / DeviceProfiles.ini), a frozen left CVar-name column, and Copy/Save scope dialogs (Full Report vs Filtered CVar Names Only).

CVar Bank & Reference Library (Tab 3: Advanced Subtab):
A searchable library of 1000+ CVars loaded asynchronously via loadAlteriaXAssetsIfNeeded() on a background thread (Dispatchers.IO) from assets/alteriax_cvars.txt (AlteriaX Pastebin) and official Unreal Engine documentation.

Features:
• Source Filters: Filter by All Sources, AlteriaX Pastebin, or Unreal Engine Docs.
• Display: Toggle between Card View and high-density Table View.
• Extract Web CVars: Paste raw text or web pages to dynamically parse and import new CVars into your local database.
• Send to Editor: Tap "Send to Editor" beside any CVar to instantly jump to the Config Editor and insert it into Smart Mode under its canonical section!

Duplicate Flagger (DuplicateCvarFlagger.kt — Tab 3: Advanced Subtab > INI Integrity & Cleanup):
Scans your active INI files for duplicate CVar keys across lines and sections — duplicate keys can cause the game engine to silently apply the wrong value. It automatically protects metadata profile pointers (BaseProfileName, DeviceScore) from being flagged as duplicates.

Results are shown in DuplicateFlaggerDialog.kt with a 1-tap resolution flow so you can quickly clean up conflicting entries before they cause unexpected behavior in-game.

Forbidden CVars (Updated as of WuWa v3.6):
These CVars cause engine rejection, black screens, or game crashes when injected on mobile. The patcher provides Strip Forbidden (ForbiddenCvarStripper.kt) in Utilities > Advanced to auto-strip all forbidden CVars with 1 tap via ForbiddenCvarDialog.kt's Auto Strip All action!

Reference Link: Arglax Mobile-WuWa-Config forbidden_cvars.txt

Forbidden CVars List:
• Kuro.CppEffectsystem.UseLowMemoryPlayerEffectLruCapacity
• r.AFME.Enable, r.AsyncComputePSO, r.DetailMode, r.FEstimation.Option
• r.Kuro.SkeletalMesh.LODDistanceScale, r.Kuro.TexturePool.ExtraBudgetMB, r.KuroFI.Enable, r.KuroMaterialQualityLevel
• r.LightMaxDrawDistanceScale, r.MaterialQualityLevel, r.MFRC.Enable, r.MipMapLODBias, r.Mobile.DeviceEvaluation, r.MobileContentScaleFactor
• r.ParallelInitViews, r.RayTracing.LimitDevice, r.ScreenPercentage, r.ScreenSizeCullRatioFactor, r.SecondaryScreenPercentage.GameViewport
• r.Shadow.DistanceScale, r.Shadow.MaxCSMResolution, r.Shadow.MaxResolution
• r.streaming.AllowExtendedPoolSize, r.Streaming.Boost, r.Streaming.CPUReadback, r.Streaming.DistancePriority.Texture2DArrayPriority, r.streaming.ExtendedPoolSizeForceAllMipsThresholdPercentage, r.streaming.ExtendedPoolSizeThresholdPercentage, r.Streaming.KuroExtraPoolSize, r.Streaming.LimitPoolSizeTOVRAM, r.streaming.MaxExtendedPoolSizePercentage, r.streaming.MaxExtendedPoolsizeVRAMPercentage, r.Streaming.MaxNumTexturesTostreamPerFrame, r.Streaming.MaxTempMemoryAllowed, r.Streaming.MaxTempMemoryAllowedForTexture2DArray, r.Streaming.MinBoost, r.Streaming.MinMipForSplitRequest, r.Streaming.PoolSize, r.Streaming.PoolSizeExtraForTexture2DArray, r.Streaming.Texture2DArrayStreamOutHysteresis, r.Streaming.UseAllMips, r.Streaming.UseAsyncCPUReadback, r.Streaming.UseFixedPoolsize
• r.Streamline.DLSSG.RetainResourceswhenoff, r.TextureGroup.Landscape.TextureLODBias, r.ViewDistanceScale, r.VolumetricFog, r.VRS.EnableMaterial, r.VRS.EnableMesh, s.PriorityAsyncLoadingExtraTime

Popular & Recommended CVars for Wuthering Waves:
• r.MobileContentScaleFactor = 0.8 to 1.5 (Section: [SystemSettings] — scales 3D render resolution; use lower values on 6GB/8GB-tier devices for FPS boosts, and values closer to 1.5 only on 12GB/16GB-tier devices).
• r.ShadowQuality = 0 to 3 (Section: [SystemSettings] — shadow map detail).
• r.BloomQuality = 0 or 1 (Section: [SystemSettings] — bloom/glare post-processing).
• r.VSync = 0 or 1 (Section: [SystemSettings] — vertical sync toggle).
• r.VolumetricFog = 0 (Section: [/Script/Engine.RendererSettings] — disables heavy volumetric fog).
• s.AsyncLoadingThreadEnabled = 1 (Section: [/Script/Engine.StreamingSettings] — asynchronous background asset streaming).

Important: Avoid adding variables from the Forbidden CVars list, and always use Auto-Fix Sections in Smart Mode to ensure canonical placement. Pick a starting point based on your device's RAM tier — see the Hardware & RAM guide.

Hardware & RAM Recommendations (by physical RAM tier):
• 16 GB or higher: High-end tier — comfortably runs Extreme / High Visual presets with headroom to spare.
• 12 GB: Standard recommendation for most players — smooth performance across STABLE, PERFORMANCE, and most HIGH_VISUAL presets.
• 8 GB: Minimum recommended requirement for the C# Environment (-ForceEnableCSharpEnvironment). Below this, C# scripting risks memory pressure and force-closes during combat scenes or map loading.
• 6 GB: Minimum requirement for low-end configs — best suited to STABLE or PERFORMANCE presets with the C# Environment left disabled.
• 4 GB: May strongly experience bad performance (stutters, force-closes, long load times). Vanilla defaults or the lowest presets are recommended, and a device upgrade is recommended for a meaningfully better experience.

Check Your Device Hardware:
Go to Utilities > Common > Get Device Info (DeviceStatsCollector.kt). It extracts your exact GPU renderer, Vulkan driver version, physical RAM, CPU core count, C# environment status, and game-evaluated Device Score directly from Client.log!

CVar Extractor & Main Storage Reader (Tab 3: Advanced Subtab > Log Extraction & Main Storage):
• Extract Log CVars (CVarExtractor.kt): Parses decrypted Client.log line-by-line and tags each CVar with a change-frequency remark: Static (constants set once at engine init), Var 1 / Var 2 / Var 3 (CVars modified during scene loading or graphic changes), or Hyper (rapidly updating runtime CVars per frame). Results open in CVarExtractorDialog.kt with TXT and CSV export options.
• Main Storage Reader (MainStorageReaderDialog.kt): Inspects persistent backups saved in context.filesDir/app_main_storage/backups/. View, copy, or share any timestamped INI backup, and use the 1-tap Restore Backup button to instantly revert to a previous configuration snapshot.

Utilities & Log Diagnostics (Tab 3: Common Subtab):
• Decrypted Log Explorer: Real-time viewer for Client.log with line numbers and filter chips (LogConfig, GameThread, Sharphereal, LogInit, LogTemp, Vulkan, RHI).
• Get Device Info (DeviceStatsCollector.kt): Extracts GPU renderer, Vulkan driver version, physical RAM, CPU core count, C# environment status, and game-evaluated Device Score.
• Log Decryptor (LogDecryptor.kt): Decrypts obfuscated logs using Scheme A (XOR 0xA5/0xEF), Scheme B (XOR 0x55), or Plaintext fallback. Supports full-screen DecryptedLogViewerDialog.kt and Sharesheet export.
• Delete Logs: Runs elevated rm -rf on .../Saved/Logs/ to reclaim gigabytes of storage.
• Export & Sharing (PatchExporter.kt): Opens a picked SAF folder or compresses active INIs into a custom-named ZIP for the Android Sharesheet.
• Main Storage: Inspects snapshots in context.filesDir/app_main_storage/ with 1-tap Restore Backup.

Backend Activity Log: Tap View Backend Activity Log (ActivityLogDialog.kt) to see every trigger, IPC event, and exception recorded at context.filesDir/activity_log.txt — for example: [timestamp] Checked section guards for Engine.ini before save. Found 2 misplaced/prefixed item(s).

Settings Tab (Tab 4: SettingsScreen):
• Help & Guide: The Ultimate Patching Guide opens an in-app onboarding walkthrough; Official Documentation currently shows an "Under Construction" notice.
• Preferences Card: Toggle Help Tooltips, Patch Notifications, Haptics, Sound Effects, and DND at Work. Tap Reset to Defaults to restore factory preference values.
• Application Info: Shows the current app version. Tap Check for Updates to query the GitHub release API (UpdateChecker.kt) against app-version.txt. The Elevated Access Status card shows your active backend badge, with a Grant Root button (prompts Magisk/KernelSU/APatch/SuperSU via libsu) and Shizuku Setup/Refresh buttons.
• Quick Jumps: One-tap shortcuts to Developer Options, Wireless Debugging, the Shizuku app, the AXManager app, the WuWaLab companion app, and the Metadata Generator.
• What's New Card: Renders the current release's highlights, linking to ChangelogDialog.kt.

Settings Screen & Danger Zone (Tab 4: SettingsScreen):
• Danger Zone (normally collapsed; 3-step guarded confirmation actions):
- Delete Shaders (DeleteShadersDialog.kt): Wipes Vulkan (VulkanProgramBinaryCache) or OpenGL (ProgramBinaryCache) compiled shader caches to resolve graphic glitches and shader compile crashes after game updates.
- Clear App Cache & History: Wipes temporary repository zip caches and editor undo/redo snapshot stacks.
- Clear App Data & Exports: Complete factory reset for custom repository URLs, exports, and preference toggles.
- Clear Activity Log: Erases context.filesDir/activity_log.txt.
• See the Preferences & Quick Jumps guide for the rest of the Settings tab (toggles, update checker, Grant Root, shortcuts).

title: Remediation: Game Crashing, Lag, Stutter, or Black Screen

response.text:
Troubleshooting: Game Crashing, Black Screen, or Stuttering:
Follow these remediation steps in order:

Step 1: Revert to Clean Vanilla Defaults
Go to Utilities > Common > Vanilla mode and tap the red Revert to Vanilla button. This deletes modified Engine.ini, DeviceProfiles.ini, and Scalability.ini so Kuro Games factory defaults regenerate on launch.

Step 2: Delete Corrupted Shader Caches
Go to Settings > Danger Zone > Delete Shaders (DeleteShadersDialog.kt) and clear both Vulkan and OpenGL caches. Shader corruption often occurs following game version updates.

Step 3: Strip Forbidden CVars
Go to Utilities > Advanced Subtab > Strip Forbidden (ForbiddenCvarStripper.kt) and tap Auto Strip All.

Step 4: Check C# Environment & RAM Pressure
If your device has less than 8 GB RAM, open Editor > Misc Patch and uncheck -ForceEnableCSharpEnvironment. See the RAM tier guide for what to expect at your device's RAM level.

Step 5: Still not resolved?
If the issue persists, open Support > Report a Bug (BugReportDialog.kt) to send your device diagnostics and activity_log.txt directly to developer Arglax on Discord or GitHub.

title: Remediation: Shizuku Not Working or Access NONE

response.text:
Troubleshooting: Elevated Access "NONE" or Shizuku Issues:
Follow these steps to restore elevated permissions:

Step 1: Check Shizuku Service Status
Open the Shizuku standalone app. Ensure it reports "Shizuku is running". If stopped, re-pair using Wireless Debugging and enter the 6-digit code.

Step 2: Xiaomi / HyperOS / MIUI Mandatory Fix
Inside Android Developer Options, you must enable "USB Debugging (Security Settings)" (requires Mi Account login). Without this, Xiaomi blocks Shizuku from executing file writes.

Step 3: Refresh or Revoke Permission
Go to Settings Tab > Application Info in WuWa Config Patcher and tap the Refresh icon. If still failing, open the Shizuku app, revoke permissions for WuWa Config Patcher, force stop the patcher, and reopen it to prompt approval again.

Step 4: Alternative Backends
If your device is rooted, tap Grant Root in Settings to use native SU via libsu.

Step 5: Still failing?
Report the issue to developer Arglax via Support > Report a Bug with your backend log.

title: Remediation: Vibrant Red CVars & Failed Section Checks

response.text:
Troubleshooting: Vibrant Red Text (#FF2222) & Misplaced CVars:

Step 1: Use 1-Tap Auto-Fix Sections
When saving in Config Editor, tap Auto-Fix Sections in the dialog. The patcher will automatically strip illegal CVars= prefixes from Engine.ini and route variables to canonical headers (e.g. r. to RendererSettings, s. to StreamingSettings, n./p. network CVars to NetworkSettings).

Step 2: Verify in CVar Analyzer
After launching the game, open Utilities > Advanced > Analyze Config (CVarAnalyzer.kt). If a CVar shows DELETED BY GAME, Kuro's runtime explicitly stripped it because it is either protected, obsolete, or listed in the Forbidden CVars bank.

Step 3: Check Whitelisted Headers
Remember that [Core.Paths], [Core.System], and [/Script/Engine.RendererOverrideSettings] are whitelisted and never altered.

Bug Reporting & Creator Support (Tab 5: SupportScreen):
• Backend Activity Log: Every action, Shizuku IPC binder call, and exception is logged to context.filesDir/activity_log.txt by ActionLogger.log() / ActionLogger.logException(). Inspect it in Utilities > View Backend Activity Log.
• Report a Bug Generator (BugReportDialog.kt): Tap "Report a Bug / Suggest a Feature" on the Support tab. It automatically packages device specs and recent logs to send directly to developer Arglax via Email, Discord, or GitHub Issues.
• Community & Utilities: Direct links to Arglax's official Discord and GitHub, plus a showcase card for the WuWaLab companion app.
• Support Arglax: The application is 100% free and ad-free. You can donate directly via the in-app GCash / InstaPay QR dialog (GCashDialog.kt).

title: Manual Mode Guide (Old School File Managers)

response.text:
Manual Mode (Android 11–13 Fallback):
If unable to run Shizuku or Root:
1. Go to Utilities > Export & Sharing > Share Patch and extract the INIs.
2. Using FV File Explorer, ZArchiver, or MT Manager, copy the files to:
/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/<package>/files/UE4Game/Client/Client/Saved/Config/Android/

⚠️ Android 14 / 15 Note: Google has strictly locked down /Android/data/ access on newer OS versions. Shizuku or Root access is required on Android 14 and 15+.
You're very welcome! 🙌 Feel free to ask if you need help with presets, CVars, Shizuku, or diagnostics.
Take care! 👋 Come back anytime you need tuning or troubleshooting assistance for WuWa Config Patcher.
